title: Mara and the Promise
author: J. M. Amberdale
blurb: Astrid Montrose, a lighthouse keeper's granddaughter and part-time novelist, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. Then a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
